# MetroFuse 10.0 Beta 10

- Enabled the player's video button for active music plugins that support video playback, including video canvas support.
- Preserved plugin video thumbnails and avoided invalid YouTube artwork URLs for plugin tracks and Windows downloads.
- Improved fallback artwork for YouTube video thumbnails.
- Grouped provider and offline search results into songs, videos, and podcast episodes.

Install the signed Android APK over your current beta. On Windows, extract the x64 ZIP and run the launcher.
